name: Mori Hou Shudian
source:
Even at the end of the world, people still want to talk, eat, and fall in love.

This is a story from after the end. And an utterly ordinary, everyday story.

A perfect future once run entirely by AI collapsed overnight in an event known as the Great Silence. Failing machines, scarce energy, rival factions... Light up the bookstore and offer a little comfort at the barren end of the world.

A provisional government soldier, a merchant roaming the wasteland, a burnt-out engineer, a wandering musician... Each customer pushes open the door carrying their own past and worries. Listen to their stories and pick the right book for them—perhaps it will change their future.

A girl who hates robots and an emotionless old-model android. Together they prepare drinks and meals and welcome every customer who walks in. How will their relationship change over time?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5374060]Steam[/url]]
